office_does: The County Clerk keeps the Cowlitz County Superior Court's case records and runs the office that takes court filings from the public.
race_blurb: Clerk Staci Myklebust, in office about 12 years, faces former lead deputy clerk Ashley White; both run as Independents on court-records administration.

candidates.summary: Cowlitz County Clerk for about 12 years, with 23 years in the office, seeking another term to add electronic filing and public services.
highlights: Clerk for about 12 years, 23 years in the office combined [S1]
Goal: implement an electronic filing system and increase public services [S1]
Running as an Independent: 'this position is not about politics' [S1]

experience.basis: Incumbent clerk for about 12 years, with 23 years in the office, running on continuity.

candidates.summary: Army veteran and former lead deputy clerk, now at Cowlitz County Juvenile Court, promising a more modern, responsive clerk's office.
highlights: Five years in the Clerk's Office, the last two as a lead deputy clerk [S1]
Promises modernized operations, stronger customer service and transparency [S1]
U.S. Army veteran; works at Cowlitz County Juvenile Court [S1]

experience.basis: No elected office; challenges a long-serving incumbent on modernization while drawing on five years inside the office.
